"""Error-path and limit tests derived from the contract."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"


def run(raw_bytes):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN], input=raw_bytes,
                       capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit("rc=%d stderr=%s" % (p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]))
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode("utf-8").splitlines()]


CASES = []


def case(name, payload, expected):
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        payload = payload.encode("utf-8")
    CASES.append((name, payload, expected))


E = lambda c: {"ok": False, "error": c}

# --- stage 1: length / utf-8
case("empty stream", b"", [])
case("blank line", b"\n", [E("E_JSON")])
case("whitespace only", b"   \n", [E("E_JSON")])
case("invalid utf-8", b'{"services":[\xff\xfe"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\n', [E("E_JSON")])
big = b'{"services":["' + b"a" * (1048576 - 20) + b'"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}'
case("line too long", big + b"\n", [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("line at limit ok", b'{"services":["' + b"a" * (1048576 - 20) + b'"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}',
     [E("E_LIMIT")])  # service token too long -> E_LIMIT as well

# --- stage 2: depth
case("depth 64 ok", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":' + '{"op":"not","arg":' * 60 + '{"op":"true"}' + '}' * 60 + '}],"queries":[]}',
     None)  # depth: request(1) rules-array(2) rule(3) when(4) + 60 nested + inner -> too deep? computed below
case("depth 65 -> limit", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":' + '{"op":"not","arg":' * 62 + '{"op":"true"}' + '}' * 62 + '}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("depth over limit in malformed text", "[" * 70 + "garbage", [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("unbalanced close brackets ok depth", "]" * 100, [E("E_JSON")])

# --- stage 3: json
case("invalid json", "{", [E("E_JSON")])
case("trailing garbage", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]} x', [E("E_JSON")])
case("NaN", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":NaN}', [E("E_JSON")])
case("Infinity", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":Infinity}', [E("E_JSON")])
case("-Infinity", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":-Infinity}', [E("E_JSON")])
case("duplicate keys", '{"services":[],"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', [E("E_JSON")])
case("duplicate nested keys", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":{"a":1,"a":2}}', [E("E_JSON")])
case("unterminated final line", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', None)

# --- stage 4: schema
case("top-level array", "[]", [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("top-level string", '"x"', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("missing key", '{"services":[],"rules":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("extra key", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"extra":1}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("services not list", '{"services":"a","rules":[],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("service not string", '{"services":[1],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("duplicate service", '{"services":["a","a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("empty service", '{"services":[""],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("lone surrogate service", '{"services":["\\ud800"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("surrogate pair service", '{"services":["\\ud83d\\ude00"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', None)
case("rules not list", '{"services":[],"rules":{},"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("rule extra key", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"},"x":1}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("rule missing key", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow"}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("bad action", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"deny","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("bad op", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"xor"}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("atom extra key", '{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["a"],"x":1}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("atom missing path", '{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match"}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("path token unknown", '{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["b"]}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("path not list", '{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":"a"}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("not missing arg", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"not"}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("and args not list", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"and","args":{}}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("when not object", '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":true}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("queries not list", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":{}}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("query token unknown", '{"services":["x"],"rules":[],"queries":[["unknown"]]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("query not list", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":["a"]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("lone surrogate in path", '{"services":["\\ud800"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["\\ud800"]}}],"queries":[]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])
case("lone surrogate in query", '{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[["\\udc00"]]}', [E("E_SCHEMA")])

# --- stage 5: limits
case("25 services", json.dumps({"services": ["s%d" % i for i in range(25)], "rules": [], "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("24 services ok", json.dumps({"services": ["s%d" % i for i in range(24)], "rules": [], "queries": []}), None)
case("service 65 chars", json.dumps({"services": ["a" * 65], "rules": [], "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("service 64 chars", json.dumps({"services": ["a" * 64], "rules": [], "queries": []}), None)
case("33 rules", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}] * 33, "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("32 rules ok", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}] * 32, "queries": []}), None)
case("17 token path", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"] * 17}}], "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("16 token path ok", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"] * 16}}], "queries": []}), None)
case("33 args", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "true"}] * 33}}], "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("32 args ok", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "true"}] * 32}}], "queries": []}), None)
case("11 distinct atoms", json.dumps({"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": [c]}} for c in "ab"] +
    [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": [c]}} for c in "ab"] +
    [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": [c]}} for c in "ab"] +
    [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": [c]}} for c in "ab"] +
    [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a", "b"]}}],
    "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("257 queries", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [[]] * 257}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("256 queries ok", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [[]] * 256}), None)
case("query 4097 tokens", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4097]}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("query 4096 tokens ok", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096]}), None)
case("total query tokens 16385", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096] * 4 + [["a"]]}), [E("E_LIMIT")])

# node limit: 256 nodes ok, 257 not
def nodes_expr(n):
    # binary tree of "and" nodes: build n nodes total
    # simplest: chain of "not" nodes
    e = {"op": "true"}
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        e = {"op": "not", "arg": e}
    return e
case("257 nodes", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": nodes_expr(257)}], "queries": []}), [E("E_LIMIT")])
case("256 nodes ok", json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": nodes_expr(256)}], "queries": []}), None)

# --- multi-line behaviour
CASES.append(("multi line", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\n{"bad"\n{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}',
              [{"ok": True, "dfa": {"start": 0, "accept": [False], "next": [[]], "distance": [None]}, "queries": []},
               E("E_JSON"),
               {"ok": True, "dfa": {"start": 0, "accept": [False], "next": [[]], "distance": [None]}, "queries": []}]))

failed = 0
for name, payload, expected in CASES:
    got = run(payload)
    if expected is None:
        print("INFO  %-32s -> %s" % (name, json.dumps(got)[:160]))
        continue
    if got != expected:
        failed += 1
        print("FAIL  %-32s -> %s (want %s)" % (name, json.dumps(got)[:200], json.dumps(expected)[:200]))
print("failures:", failed, "of", len(CASES))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/errors.py
